title: SwarmAgentic: Towards Fully Automated Agentic System Generation via Swarm Intelligence
authors: Yao Zhang; Chenyang Lin; Shijie Tang; Haokun Chen; Shijie Zhou; Yunpu Ma; Volker Tresp
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2025

problem_statement.en: Existing frameworks that automate agentic-system design lack full autonomy: they depend on predefined agents, fixed templates or hand-crafted seed agents, and typically optimize agent functionality and inter-agent collaboration separately. The paper targets fully autonomous generation of a complete multi-agent system from scratch — jointly optimizing agent roles/policies and their coordination — given only a task description and an objective function.
problem_statement.zh: 現有自動化 agentic system 設計的框架缺乏完整的自主性:其依賴於預先定義的 agent、固定的模板或人工設計的種子 agent,且通常將 agent 功能與 agent 之間的協作分開最佳化。本論文的目標為在僅給定任務描述與目標函數的條件下,從零開始完整地自主生成一套完整的 multi-agent system,並聯合最佳化 agent 的角色/策略及其協調機制。

key_innovation.en: Reformulates Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) as a symbolic, language-based process over a population of complete agentic systems encoded as structured text/code, and introduces a "Failure-Aware Velocity Update" in which an LLM diagnoses execution flaws and computes textual edits that move each particle toward its personal-best and the swarm's global-best system, jointly optimizing agent functionality and collaboration offline.
key_innovation.zh: 本方法將 Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO)重新表述為一個以語言為基礎的符號化流程,作用於一群以結構化文字/程式碼編碼的完整 agentic system 個體之上,並引入「Failure-Aware Velocity Update」機制:由 LLM 診斷執行過程中的缺陷,並計算文字層級的編輯,使每個 particle 朝其個體最佳(personal-best)與群體全域最佳(global-best)的系統移動,從而在離線階段聯合最佳化 agent 功能與協作。

baselines_compared: Direct, CoT, Self-Refine, SPP, EvoAgent, ADAS

key_improvements.zh: 各結果數值以 GPT-3.5 executor / GPT-4o executor 形式呈現(而非 micro/macro)。TravelPlanner 最終 pass rate:SwarmAgentic 為 3.3 / 32.2,ADAS 為 1.1 / 8.9,EvoAgent 為 1.1 / 7.2,相對 ADAS 取得 +261.8% 的相對增益。Natural Plan:Trip Planning 13.1 / 13.1(最佳 baseline CoT 為 9.0 / 1.0;ADAS 為 1.9 / 3.1),Meeting Planning 23.0 / 56.0(ADAS 為 11.0 / 43.0),Calendar Scheduling 28.0 / 82.0(ADAS 為 21.0 / 66.0;SPP 為 22.0 / 44.0)。Creative Writing 8.2 / 8.5(ADAS 為 6.2 / 7.3;SPP 為 5.9 / 7.6)。MGSM 65.6 / 88.4(SPP 為 55.2 / 84.9;ADAS 為 29.0 / 87.0)。將以 GPT-4o-mini 發現的 Creative-Writing 系統跨模型遷移至其他 executor,於各項皆勝過所有 baseline:8.5(GPT-4o)、8.3(Claude-3.5-sonnet)、9.0(DeepSeek-V3)、7.5(Gemini-1.5)、7.8(以 Gemini-1.5-flash 訓練 -> 於 Gemini-1.5-Pro 測試)。消融實驗(CW,20 個 instances):移除 Failure-Driven Adjustments 使分數由 8.8 降至 8.4,移除 Agent-Level Adaptation 降至 7.3,移除 Collaborative-Structures Reconfiguration 降至 6.7。

structure_space: Team composition (agent set), Roles / profiles, Prompts (joint), Workflow code, Operator / node graph
decision_mechanism: Evolutionary / swarm search, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Textual feedback, Validation-set score
benchmarks_used: TravelPlanner, Natural Plan, Creative Writing, MGSM

agent_scenario.en: Fully automated, from-scratch generation of role-based multi-agent systems. A candidate system contains a variable-size set of LLM agents — each defined by a role identifier, a responsibility description, and an execution policy — orchestrated by a collaborative structure that sequences execution steps, assigns agents to steps, and routes information between them. A single optimizer LLM (GPT-4o-mini-0718) drives the swarm search offline; the discovered system's agents then run on separate executor LLMs. The framework is general-purpose across six domains (long-horizon travel planning, trip/meeting/calendar scheduling, creative writing, multilingual math). Agents operate purely in a text environment — no external tools, retrieval, or real-world perception/action are used (explicitly noted as a limitation). A case study on TravelPlanner shows the swarm introducing a "Quality Assurance Specialist" and verification steps that raise success rate from ~11% to 22% to 33% across iterations.
agent_scenario.zh: 完整自動化、從零開始生成以角色為基礎的 multi-agent system。一個候選系統包含一組大小可變的 LLM agent,每個 agent 由角色識別碼、職責描述與執行策略所定義,並由一個協作結構加以編排,該結構負責排定執行步驟的順序、將 agent 指派至各步驟,並在各 agent 之間傳遞資訊。單一的最佳化 LLM(GPT-4o-mini-0718)於離線階段驅動 swarm 搜尋;所發現系統中的 agent 隨後於不同的 executor LLM 上運行。該框架具通用性,涵蓋六個領域(長程旅行規劃、行程/會議/行事曆排程、創意寫作、多語言數學)。各 agent 純粹於文字環境中運作,不使用任何外部工具、檢索或真實世界的感知/行動(論文明確指出此為一項限制)。針對 TravelPlanner 的案例研究顯示,swarm 引入了「Quality Assurance Specialist」與驗證步驟,使成功率於各次迭代中由約 11% 提升至 22% 再至 33%。
